query:
-- Check which Harver slots 7, 11, 12 are open (need attendeeNumber 2)
SELECT m.timeSlot, m.attendeeNumber, m.attendeeId
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE s.companyName = 'Harver' AND m.timeSlot IN (7, 11, 12) AND m.isVisible = 1
ORDER BY m.timeSlot, m.attendeeNumber;
